name: Roman Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description:
Roman Mahjong is a free mahjong game.

Ancient Rome was a vast wasteland of conquered countries, territories and cultures. All who fell to the swords and sandals of the their unholy emperor. The lineage of their power reaches back through ancient times and some might say that the empire never ended. The background of this online game is designed with the historical architecture of the Roman world. The tiles have beautiful Roman designs with bold colors like red, green, purple, and orange. If you make an error or get stuck, you have the option to shuffle, undo, and take a hint. With each level, you get 3 of each. However, either option will lower your overall score. There are multiple levels of this online game for you to play and win! Each level has its own pattern and challenge as the game becomes more difficult. On top of differing patterns, each level is timed so you must solve each puzzle as quickly as possible. Don’t be deterred, though! Play through all the levels with the best score possible to land on our list of High Scores!
